body.objective: Construct the actual residual BFV/Koszul receiver of the selected two-phase counterflow Berger theory on its certified fixed-charge physical reduction, using the background's true stabilizer algebra rather than importing the round-cylinder fifteen-generator quotient.
body.stop_condition: Import the terminal fixed-charge reduced-health result, the background-neighborhood/stabilizer disposition and TWO_PHASE_COUNTERFLOW_CAUSAL_BV_PARENT_V1 by hashes. Compute the complete infinitesimal automorphism algebra preserving the selected metric, counterflow, auxiliary diagonal-U1 structure, action couplings and fixed-Q_rel leaf, including lifted spatial isometries, K, raw D, R_rel and global diagonal gauge reducibilities. Build its exact moment-map/Taub ideal and BFV/Koszul receiver, classify reducibility and zero modes, and construct the local-to-time-slice chain map and causal Cartan contractions on the declared support class. Compute residual cohomology and the descended pairing, proving exactly which generators become null and which remain charged. Compare with the old round-cylinder SO(4,2) fifteen-generator receiver by an explicit preserved/broken-generator map; absence of a generator is not a quotient. Land either a complete cyclic residual contraction or the first exact obstruction, with independent Lie/bracket, charge, nilpotency, chain-map and pairing verifiers, symmetry-breaking mutations, schema, receipt, report and atlas fragment.
body.current_gate: background-correct residual quotient and D/K verdict for the two-phase counterflow theory
